summary: Duke Energy Carolinas filed an 8-K reporting regulatory approvals for a utility combination whereby Duke Energy Progress will merge into Duke Energy Carolinas. Duke Energy Corp will contribute its 100% equity interest in Duke Energy Carolinas to Progress Energy prior to the merger. Terms: no purchase price disclosed; targeted effective date January 1, 2027. FERC, PSCSC, and NCUC have approved; final approval requires boards of Duke Energy Carolinas, Duke Energy Progress, and Progress Energy, and a definitive agreement. Watch for final board approvals and definitive agreement execution before year-end.
